description: Observed durations per stage of a Turkish citizenship-by-investment file, as seen by Ra Legal. These are not official figures. No Turkish authority publishes an end-to-end processing time and no statute sets a deadline; the only official artefact is the Ankara Governorship service-standards row, which covers one stage. Published so that the figure quoted on ralegal.com.tr, in the connector and here is one figure.

stages.label: Investment completed to certificate of conformity
Residence permit under Law No. 6458 Art. 31(1)(j)
Citizenship file submitted to the citizenship decision

endToEnd.label: About 4 to 10 months from the completed investment to the citizenship decision

queryAfterRule: A wait is treated as materially delayed once it exceeds the stage high bound by 40 per cent. queryAfter is the first whole number of weeks that exceeds it.
caveats: Individual outcomes vary with nationality, name-match hits and application volume.
Not a prediction for any particular file and not legal advice.
